visualize_anatomy.title: Read the platform's anatomy
visualize_anatomy.description: Read this host's composed platform anatomy: packages, roles, facets, vocabulary, tools, commands, rules, effects, routes, views, kits, themes, skills and secret names. Declaration, loading and binding are separate facts; an unobserved category is not globally absent. Returns the same filtered JSON snapshot as /visualize/anatomy, with coverage and node-only selection counts. Edges are kept only between included nodes. This reads no entity data or secret values and does not force lazy facets to load.

group.description: one anatomy group; omitted means every group

search.description: plain-text anatomy search, not a graph query

id.description: one exact anatomy part id, not a stored entity id

limit.description: maximum nodes shown; selection reports total, matching and shown counts with a truncation flag

visualize_activity.title: Capture causal platform activity
visualize_activity.description: Capture bounded causal activity from this tool host's process-local trace channel: apply phases, rules, queries, gets, effects, requests and fanout. Returns the same JSON capture DTO as /visualize/activity: epoch, events with sequence and causal span ids, a known omitted record count (gap) and explicit process-local coverage. Recording is subscriber-only; no earlier idle work is reconstructed and another process using the same store is not covered. Uses the existing trace stream, never a second measurement stream. Events carry fixed operation names, durations and counts, never query text, entity contents, payloads or secret values. A zero duration is valid.

limit.description: maximum retained activity events, including start and end events

wait.description: milliseconds to keep this capture subscribed; zero reads only available history
